title: Stop the hero departure fade from washing out and sliding a section-tall hero (/themes/nocturne's fog band)

source.ref: Visual sweep 2026-11-02, scrolled frames of /themes/nocturne at 1280: the Website and Email template sections rendered at a tenth of their opacity, then a full viewport of fog with one orb before 'Five tools. Five logins.'

detail:
SiteFx fades a .phero's wrap to 10% and slides it up by a quarter of the scroll as the hero leaves the screen. That assumes a one-screen photo hero. Nocturne's hero carries the four-surface cascade (Spotlight, Space, Website, Email) and is 3480px tall at 1280x900, so by the Email section the wrap sat at opacity 0.1 translated 675px up its own box: the content read as fog and the box's last 675px were empty. Measured in the browser at scrollY 2700: .nf-hero > .wrap style opacity 0.1, transform translate3d(0,-675px,0). Fix: the departure runs only on a hero no taller than 1.5 viewports (PHERO_MAX_SCREENS); the one-screen heroes on Discover, People, Spaces and the rest are unchanged.

 Fixed 2026-11-02; browser check on the branch: /themes/nocturne at scrollY 2700 shows the Email template section at full opacity with no fog band; /discover's hero still fades on the way out.
